L848@P24: B3. Identity and Authentication
L849@P24: • Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is required for all AI Provider personnel with any
L850@P24: access to production systems
L851@P24: • Students and educators accessing the AI Provider Educational Product must
L852@P24: authenticate through the Academy's existing identity provider (SSO via SAML 2.0, OAuth
L853@P24: 2.0, or equivalent) wherever technically feasible
L854@P24: • Session tokens must expire after a period of inactivity.
L855@P24: • Password policies must be able to meet or exceed NIST SP 800-63B Digital Identity
L856@P24: Guidelines when configured by the Academy.
L857@P24: B4. Audit Logging
L858@P24: • All access to Covered Data must be logged with sufficient detail to reconstruct a
L859@P24: complete audit trail
L860@P24: • Logs must be retained for a minimum of 180 days.
L861@P24: • Log integrity must be protected (logs must not be modifiable by standard users)
L862@P24: • The Academy must be able to query audit logs through an administrative interface or
L863@P24: upon request
L864@P24: B5. Penetration Testing
L865@P24: • Annual external penetration testing is required at minimum; semi-annual testing is
L866@P24: strongly preferred for systems serving under-13 students
L867@P24: • Testing must cover both the application layer and the underlying infrastructure
L868@P24: • Critical and high-severity findings must be remediated within 30 days of identification
L869@P24: • Medium-severity findings must be remediated within 90 days
L870@P24: • A summary of findings and remediation status must be shared with the Academy within
L871@P24: 30 days of each test
